<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 276.0666, which in positive‑mode ESI most likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of about 275.059 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈16 % M+1 intensity) indicates roughly 14–15 carbons. A formula that matches this mass and carbon count is C₁₅H₁₅O₅ (exact monoisotopic mass = 275.0919 Da, within experimental tolerance). No other heteroatoms are required to explain the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>C15H15O5</final_answer>
